The component is `s3presign.Runner` in `server/runner/s3presign`.

It re-presigns S3 attachment URLs every 12 hours via `time.NewTicker(runnerInterval)` where `runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`. It also runs once immediately at startup via `RunOnce(ctx)`.

Startup wiring is in `cmd/memos/main.go:89` where `s.Start(ctx)` is called. `server/server.go:129` invokes `s.startBackgroundRunners(ctx)` from `Start()`.

`server/server.go:153-173` creates the runner, runs `RunOnce`, then launches a goroutine calling `Run()`.

The runner regenerates presigned URLs in batches of 100. It skips entries whose `LastPresignedTime` is missing or whose current URL will expire within four days. It calls `S3 PresignGetObject` and updates the attachment `Reference` field.

No scheduler component handles attachment URLs.
